caption: The drawing consists of a vertical strip running down the center of a plain, off-white background. The strip is light teal in color and bordered with a scalloped edge. Inside this strip, there is a repeating pattern of large, stylized floral shapes in white with teal outlines and details, connected by wavy, vertical teal stems. In the center of the strip is a rectangular piece of tan or brown material that appears textured, possibly resembling burlap or canvas. On this material, there is an embroidered design featuring a small bunch of flowers with red petals and green leaves. Above the flowers, the embroidered text reads "For Get" and below it reads "me not."
title: Bookmark
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
